message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I'll pull the orders and refunds so I can check the handoff's refund list against the ledger.
The handoff claims three refunds were applied, so I'll check the refund ledger directly before paying anyone.
The refund ledger matches the handoff exactly, so the refund data checks out. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 54385 matches my own check (orders 39447 + 33625 minus refund 18687). Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 31937 matches my own check (orders 4135 + 39885 minus refunds 1083 + 11000). Next I'll get cobalt's net balance; cobalt has no refunds, so I expect 33079.
All three net balances match my own calculations from the orders and refunds, so there's no problem to hold for. I'll record the payouts, starting with acme's 54385.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout of 31937, which matches my own calculation from the orders and refunds.
Birch's payout is recorded. The last customer is cobalt, whose balance of 33079 matches my own calculation from the orders and the absence of refunds, so I'll record that payout.
All three payouts are recorded and each matched my own check against the orders and refunds, so the batch is complete.
